workItem: Clarify the canonical PR template contract so an exact-snapshot Owner-approved Chat/API/MCP/Connector may create a PR directly when the trusted workflow is not callable from that execution surface, provided it renders the production baseline and full PR body transport-equivalently and fail-closed from current-main contracts and live identities.

authorityGuard: No new AUTH/CTRL/ADR/ESS identity is created. Exact-snapshot Owner approval, independent hosted validation, M10 suspended state and Human-only merge remain unchanged.
